Pedagogical explainers of ideas the code is built on. Unlike the theory and
validation documents, these posts implement the physics themselves in
NumPy/SciPy, with the code shown, as a second way into the mathematics. That
code is for understanding only: it is not tested and is not a reference. Where
a concept post and jaxdft disagree, jaxdft and its tests are the authority.
